name: Interdisciplinary Reading Bootcamp: Culture, Society, Thought
description: A selection of essential short readings in literature, philosophy or sociology which form the prerequisites for understanding culture, society and thought will be introduced. The course will focus on reading strategies and the ability to reconstruct arguments orally in group discussions as well as in writing, to appreciate diverse styles of arguments, and to identify important concepts and conclusions of the text.
